'''K2-A1''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] active during the [[war against Zakuul]]. It was used by the [[Eternal Alliance]] and was part of the [[Eternal Alliance Recon Unit|Alliance Recon Unit]], created and deployed in response to various uprisings sparkling across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] following the death of the [[Eternal Empire]] Empress [[Vaylin]] and reorganization of Alliance into the Eternal Alliance. K2-A1 assisted the unit in such crisises as reclaiming the stolen plans for the [[Alliance base]] from the [[Dust Vipers]] pirates, liberating [[Port Nowhere]] from [[Crimson Fang]] takeover and neutralizing Sith Lords [[Adacin]] and [[Zanisk]] in the former [[Separatist stronghold]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
K2-A1 appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' during various Uprisings.
